topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I stumbled upon my college application essay, plastered across the internet as a prime example, a guide, a model. They didn't ask. Didn't think it mattered, I suppose. Every word, every thought I poured into it, now dissected by strangers. It's out there, my aspirations, my vulnerabilities. I can almost hear them, the murmur of unseen commentators, picking apart my sentences like I'm some open book they have the right to read. I keep telling myself it’s a good thing, an honor. Yet, my fingers hover over the delete button, the cursor blinking, a silent judge. Maybe I should just let it be, but the thought of leaving it there gnaws at me.
